date:birth-of-jesus@7d6db1.note: Dated only to Augustus's decree and Cyrenius as governor (2.1-2), with the birth 'while they were there' (2.6). The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:birth-of-john-the-baptist@858502.note: Timed by Elisabeth's sixth month (1.36), her full time (1.57) and the eighth-day circumcision (1.59). The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:childhood-of-jesus@7d6db1.note: Set after the temple presentation and return to Nazareth, where the child grows (2.39-40). No year is given; the BC year depends on outside dating.

date:jesus-as-a-child-in-the-temple@9c7a.note: Jesus is twelve years old (2.42), so the year follows from the birth date. The AD year depends on dating the birth outside Scripture.

date:jesus-circumsized@7d6db1.note: Circumcised on the eighth day after birth (2.21), so the year follows the birth date. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:jesus-growing-up@78ea36.note: Begins after age twelve (2.42) and continues at Nazareth (2.51-52). The text gives no end date; the age 26 and the BC years depend on outside dating.

date:john-s-birth-predicted@a419da.note: Set in the days of Herod, king of Judaea (1.5), while Zacharias served in his course (1.8). The BC year depends on outside dating of Herod's reign.

date:mary-visits-elizabeth@858502.note: Mary goes 'in those days', after the annunciation in Elisabeth's sixth month (1.36, 1.39). The text gives no year; the BC year depends on outside dating.

date:temple-presentation-of-jesus@7d6db1.note: Timed by Mary's days of purification being accomplished after the birth (2.22). No year is given; the BC year depends on outside dating.

date:the-annuciation@858502.note: Dated only to the sixth month of Elisabeth's pregnancy (1.26, 1.36). The text gives no year; the BC year depends on outside dating.

occurred-at:birth-of-jesus>bethlehem_218.note: Joseph and Mary go up to Bethlehem (2.4), and the birth comes 'while they were there' (2.6); she bare her firstborn son (2.7).

occurred-at:childhood-of-jesus>nazareth_.note: After the temple visits they return to their own city Nazareth (2.39), where the child grows (2.40).

occurred-at:espousal-of-mary>nazareth_87.note: The angel is sent to Nazareth to the virgin espoused to Joseph (1.26-27), so the espousal is set there.

occurred-at:jesus-as-a-child-in-the-temp.note: They go up to Jerusalem for the feast (2.42) and find him in the temple there after three days (2.46).

occurred-at:john-s-birth-predicted>jerus.note: Zacharias burns incense in the temple of the Lord (1.9), where the angel appears (1.11). Jerusalem is never named in chapter 1; the city comes from outside knowledge.

parent-of:elisabeth_1152>john_1676@897c8.note: Elisabeth is to bear the son named John (1.13), brings forth a son (1.57), and his mother says he shall be called John (1.60).

participated-in:elisabeth_1152>john-s-bi.note: Named as the wife who will bear John (1.13), but she is absent from the scene; the angel speaks to Zacharias alone.

participated-in:jesus_905>birth-of-jesus.note: Mary brings forth her firstborn son (2.7), the one the angel said should be named JESUS (1.31).

participated-in:john_1676>birth-of-john-.note: Elisabeth brings forth a son (1.57), named John on the eighth day (1.59-60).

participated-in:joseph_1715>temple-prese.note: The parents, Joseph and Mary, bring the child Jesus into the temple (2.22, 2.27); Joseph is named among them (2.33).

participated-in:zacharias_2971>john-s-bi.note: The angel of the Lord appears to Zacharias and speaks to him (1.11-13).

partner-of:elisabeth_1152>zacharias_2971.note: Elisabeth is named as the wife of Zacharias (1.5).
